title: CORE Mapping
description:
A declarative field-to-field mapping between two CORE DataStructures. Each exported Mapping document carries '$schema': 'https://civitasconnect.digital/core/mapping/v1' so it is self-describing.

Note: the 'x-core-ref' annotations on 'source' and 'target' express a semantic constraint (the value must be the name of a known DataStructure). This constraint can only be fully enforced when the Mapping is validated in the context of a CORE DataSet manifest (core-ir.schema.json).

source.description: Name of the source DataStructure (the schema being read from).

target.description: Name of the target DataStructure (the schema being written to).

fields.description: Map of target field paths to their field operations.

CopyFieldOperation.description: Copies a value from a source field path.

ConcatFieldOperation.description: Concatenates multiple source field values with an optional separator.

ConstFieldOperation.description: Writes a constant literal value into the target field regardless of source data.

value.description: The constant value. Can be a string, number, or boolean.

MappingField.description: A field mapping — either a shorthand source path string or a full operation object.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for a copy operation: value is the source path.
